change.title: Establish the R2 versioned runtime journal schema
change.summary: Introduces a nested versioned runtime-transaction record while keeping the root Config schema at v4 and retaining the exact unversioned V1 wire shape for all production writers. The compatibility reader distinguishes missing nested version as V1 and nested schema v2 as a typed journal, rejects unknown versions, malformed legacy stages, unknown fields, and illegal V2 phase/exposure combinations, and keeps V2 fail-closed until later R2 writer slices. Frontend DTOs, command/event names, checkpoint timing, runtime effects, and recovery policy are unchanged.
